SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-04' THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-03' THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-03' THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS net_revenue_growth_ratio FROM sales_facts WHERE month IN ('2026-03', '2026-04')

SELECT ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND order_date < '2026-05-01' THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01' THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01' THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS net_revenue_growth_ratio FROM sales_facts WHERE order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND order_date < '2026-05-01' LIMIT 201
